# Bratrax

> Bratrax shows direct-to-consumer brands on Shopify or WooCommerce which ads make money and what's left after ad spend. It connects the store and its ad accounts, traces each order back to the visits and ads that came before it, and shows revenue, ad spend, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, cohorts and customer lifetime value in ready-made dashboards. Bratrax Lite is self-serve: $1 for the first month, then $99/month flat, month to month, live in under 10 minutes.

Key facts:

- Platforms: Shopify (any paid plan) and WooCommerce. External landing pages and Funnelish funnels through the Bratrax tracking pixel.
- Ad and marketing integrations: Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, Pinterest Ads, Taboola, Outbrain, Klaviyo, Bloomreach.
- Attribution: five standard models (first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, position-based), with an order-by-order view of each customer journey.
- Profit: MER and blended ROAS on the Store Performance dashboard; contribution margin (sales minus returns, ad spend and shipping) on the Attribution dashboard; ROAS and CPA by channel, campaign and ad.
- Order-level proof: click any attributed order count to see the orders behind it and each order's full journey, with the credited touchpoint highlighted.
- Multiple stores and teams: one account and one subscription can hold several stores, with unlimited teammates (Admin or Viewer) at no extra cost.
- Data: about a year of store history and 60 days of ad history are imported on connect. Read-only: nothing is written to the store or sent back to ad platforms. No REST API; programmatic access is through the MCP endpoint.
- AI: connect Claude to your data through Bratrax's MCP endpoint, or ask the Bratrax assistant in Slack. ChatGPT support is on the roadmap.
- Pricing: flat $99/month at any revenue, no contract, no GMV-based fees; one click to cancel. Clear Vision, a done-for-you analytics service, starts at $5K/month.
- Good fit: D2C brands on Shopify or WooCommerce that spend on paid ads. Not a fit: high-ticket call funnels or affiliate VSL businesses, stores on other platforms.
